scope: Published carrier-v1 files and numbered carrier rules only; carrier-profile, circuit, release and external-document versions are distinct.

repository-policy.scope: Repository policy, not ISO requirements. The canonical Git revision is historical attribution. Evidence paths provide navigation and existence checks; validation does not attest current file bytes to that revision.

multipaz-0.99.0.scope: Release identifier checked against the primary GitHub release API on 2026-11-11. Wire shape is recorded by the committed host fixture, not independent-device or ISO draft evidence.

openid4vp-1.0-final.scope: Primary OpenID4VP 1.0 Final identifier, publication date and Appendix B.2.6.1 OpenID4VPHandover checked against the versioned primary HTML on 2026-11-11. This is transcript evidence, not standardisation of the ZK carrier.

iso-second-edition.scope: Exact ISO/IEC 18013-5 second-edition draft revision unavailable; observed wire shape is attributed to Multipaz 0.99.0, not to a guessed ISO revision.
